entities.name: Roxith
entities.description: One of the Seven Steel Thanes of New Phyrexia who sought to remove the flesh of all lifeforms.

entities.name: Seven Steel Thanes
entities.description: Phyrexian rulers of New Phyrexia's spheres.

entities.name: Karn
entities.description: Revered by Roxith; rules New Phyrexia alongside Sheoldred.

entities.name: Sheoldred
entities.description: Phyrexian leader who killed Roxith and later continued his work.

entities.name: Geth
entities.description: Thane despised by Roxith for not being compleated.

entities.name: Kraynox
entities.description: Thane allied with Roxith over the Fifth Sphere.

entities.name: Thrissik
entities.description: Thane who attacked Roxith testing whether he was the Destroyer.

entities.name: Azax-Azog
entities.description: Demon who warned Roxith he would be first to fall and gave him a black cube.

entities.name: Urabrask
entities.description: Leader of a rebellion against Elesh Norn.

entities.name: Dross Pits
entities.description: Created by Sheoldred continuing Roxith's work.

events.summary: Roxith gains a partnership with Kraynox by agreeing to harvest flesh for the Fifth Sphere.
events.quote: Roxith managed to seemingly ally himself with Kraynox , the Deep Thane, by agreeing to harvest flesh

events.summary: Thrissik attacks Roxith to see if he is the Destroyer.
events.quote: the Thane attacked him to see if he was the "Destroyer" it was looking for

events.summary: Azax-Azog warns Roxith he will be the first to fall and gives him a black cube.
events.quote: the demon warned Roxith he would be the first to fall

events.summary: Roxith plans to oust Sheoldred and Karn but fails and is torn apart by the astral coffer.
events.quote: a flurry of razors and shadows tore him to pieces

events.summary: Sheoldred continues Roxith's work, creating the Dross Pits; Roxith still lives and aids Urabrask's rebellion.
events.quote: He is one of the Thanes who aided Urabrask's rebellion against Elesh Norn .

relations.quote: was one of the Seven Steel Thanes of New Phyrexia
Roxith managed to seemingly ally himself with Kraynox
He despised Geth since he wasn't a Compleated Phyrexian
